entries.subject: DART v004 SPC relative-albedo field
entries.finding: The released v004 SPC relative-albedo FITS field uses the existing source-facet material path introduced for Didymos. Its values and uncertainties are bound to the original Dimorphos mesh as the README describes.

entries.subject: DART global v004 0.972 m SPC model and radial elevation
entries.finding: The selected 98,306-vertex OBJ supplies encounter geometry and radius-minus-75 m Elevation. It is not a post-impact reconstruction, and its reference sphere is not a gravitational datum. Finer source releases do not change the current display geometry.

entries.subject: DART v004 gravity-relative slope FITS
entries.finding: The 0.972 m slope field is a separate scientific view under the source gravity assumptions, including modeled regions. The documented centroid correspondence binds reordered FITS rows to source triangles; slope is not relabeled as elevation.

entries.subject: Four calibrated DRACO frames with native geometric backplanes
entries.finding: The retained four-frame mosaic spans about 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact, including the last complete image. Native intercepts on the 0.243 m DSK are checked against the retained 0.972 m OBJ; closer frames add detail and approximately 18.08% sampled mesh coverage, not the far side.

entries.subject: DART SPICE v4.0 and independent DRACO camera check
entries.finding: Fifteen pinned kernels and the CSPICE oracle supply an independent camera/geometry check. The retained report distinguishes the archived cube’s older pointing/ephemeris from the newer kernel solution and preserves the illumination-angle offset. Kernel availability does not replace per-pixel source interpretation.

entries.subject: Local 5 cm impact-region DART models
entries.finding: The retained v003/v004 survey reviewed global and local releases. Local 5 cm impact-region products do not replace the global body and remain outside the selected geometry.
entries.revisitWhen: A separately scoped local dataset can bind the released geometry, coverage and source model without presenting it as a global surface.

entries.subject: Unselected ancillary DART FITS fields
entries.finding: The existing source account records ancillary fields beyond relative albedo and slope as unselected, without individual product-level qualification. No acceptance or absence conclusion is inferred for those fields.
entries.revisitWhen: A specific field is selected for an interpretable scientific question and its units, facet order and uncertainty are qualified.

entries.subject: LICIACube images as a separate surface texture
entries.finding: LICIACube observations contribute to the released shape, but the retained survey does not qualify them as a separate registered surface lens. The selected DRACO mosaic is independently documented.
entries.revisitWhen: A specific LICIACube image has documented camera-to-shape registration, usable coverage and calibrated interpretation.
